mappings.note: Which festival was held in Vamiro's village (पशु पर्व): content comprehension of the prescribed prose, LO-1.
Who wrote the story. Attribution of the text rather than its content or the author's style, so neither LO applies and the literature competency is cited.
What people believed about Tataara's sword: content comprehension, LO-1.
What Tataara did in his rage: comprehension of the climax, LO-1.
Where the story is set: a stated detail of the text, LO-1. Contrast qid:104285, which asks about the author's other Andaman writing.
Why Vamiro forgot her song: comprehension of a moment and its cause, LO-1.
Whose hearts were aching: content comprehension, LO-1.
Who is urging the young woman to sing: content comprehension, LO-1.
Why Tataara lost his senses: comprehension of cause within the narrative, LO-1.
How far Little Andaman lies from Port Blair: a figure given in the text, LO-1.
What changed after Vamiro's sacrificial death: comprehension of the story's outcome, LO-1. LO-2 would fit an item asking what the writer intends by that outcome.
Why neighbouring villages invited Tataara: comprehension of his standing in the story, LO-1.
Names of Mandloi's principal works: author biography from the लेखक परिचय, outside both LOs, so the literature competency.
What Mandloi's Andaman and Nicobar prose is a study of: knowledge of the author's other work, not of this text, so competency level.
What makes Mandloi's language effective: भाषा-शैली, LO-2, the appraisal outcome rather than content comprehension.
Where Mandloi was born: author biography, competency level as with qid:104284.
